Subject: Recap: Discovery — ACME / Redwood (economic buyer & procurement intro)

Hi Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps: 

Summary of scope:
- Use case: in-product LLM inference for personalized support responses (latency SLO: 200ms p95, throughput ~50 qps).
- Data: customer support transcripts (PII redaction required), model outputs logged for QA only.
- Deployment preference: Dedicated pool (VPC) for initial rollout, potentially hosted later.

Key decision criteria you called out:
1) Cost per request / predictable monthly spend (budget sensitivity).
2) Security & compliance evidence (SOC 2, audit logs, data residency).
3) Integration effort and rollout support (onboarding SOW).
4) Latency and reliability guarantees for customer-facing flows.

Requested next steps (proposed):
- Intro to economic/budget owner and procurement to align on budget and legal terms (can you loop them in?)
- I’ll share a preliminary pricing quote and SOW template (attached).
- Quick 30-min alignment call with budget/procurement + our product lead to confirm decision criteria and timeline.

Attachments: Redwood-pricing-quote-ACME-2026.pdf, SOW-template-Redwood.pdf

Proposed timeline: target decision window by mid-November to meet your Q4 rollout schedule.

If you can introduce Dana (budget) and your procurement lead that would be great — I’ll follow up with a short agenda for the intro call.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
